# elysium

> Source of Asphodel (`@saluca/asphodel` 0.3.0): a TypeScript library for local-first AI agent memory with integer ids, a topic-word index, full-text search and optional hybrid vector search, on SQLite or Postgres. FSL-1.1-ALv2.

Facts agents often get wrong: the repository is named elysium but the package inside is `@saluca/asphodel`. It is not on npm (the name was removed on 2026-09-16, and the 0.4.0 that was once published came from a different repository); build from source. It is a library, not a server or CLI. `maxMemoriesPerTopic` is an adapter option, not an `Asphodel` option. CommonJS output in dist/, Node.js 18 or later, native better-sqlite3 binding required.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/README.md): install, quickstart, API, schema, correction notes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/AGENTS.md): build and test commands for agents changing this repo

## Code

- [src/store.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/store.ts): the Asphodel API (remember, recall, search, hybridSearch, forget, list)
- [src/types.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/types.ts): Adapter, HybridProvider and option types
- [src/adapters/sqlite.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/adapters/sqlite.ts): SQLite schema, FTS5 search, sqlite-vec vectors
- [src/adapters/postgres.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/adapters/postgres.ts): Postgres adapter
- [src/hybrid/local.ts](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/src/hybrid/local.ts): LocalHybridProvider (node-llama-cpp embeddings, HyDE, rerank)
- [examples/quickstart.mjs](https://github.com/saluca-labs/elysium/blob/master/examples/quickstart.mjs): runnable quickstart against the local build
